_how_to_obtain: 1. Open https://www.facebook.com/ads/library in Chrome while logged in.
2. Open DevTools (F12) → Network tab, filter by 'graphql'.
3. Search for any keyword (e.g. 'buy') to trigger a request.
4. Find the POST request to https://www.facebook.com/api/graphql/ whose
5. Right-click → Copy → Copy as cURL (bash), then extract each field below
from the request headers and form body.
6. Tokens expire with the browser session; re-capture when you get 403s.
